# Continual-ARC notes — task-c29380b3

## Verified task pattern
A grid contains a full straight divider of color 2, a uniform background, and a non-background object on one side. Color 8 marks the object's edge/line on the side away from the divider. In examples with room, the object is translated one cell toward the divider and color 8 occupies the object's former outermost row/column (the leading outer edge away from the divider). If the object is already blocked from moving toward the divider (touching it), leave the object in place and put color 8 on the next free line beyond the object's far edge. Preserve other cells and grid dimensions.

## Demonstrations and evidence
- Demo 1: vertical divider at column 3; color-4 object is immediately to its right (touching divider). Output leaves object in place and adds full color-8 column 6, immediately beyond its far/right edge.
- Demo 3: vertical divider at column 4; single color-0 cell at row 13, column 3 (touching divider). Output leaves it in place and adds color-8 column 2, beyond its far/left edge.
- Demo 4: vertical divider at column 13; object around columns 6–11. Output shifts object one column right (toward divider) and puts 8 in its old far-left column 6.

This was confirmed CORRECT by evaluator.

2. Identify the non-background object and which side of it faces away from the divider.
3. Shift the object one cell toward the divider when there is room, and draw color 8 along the object's original far-edge row/column. If the object touches the divider and cannot shift, leave it unchanged and draw 8 on the next free line beyond its far edge.
